source_quote: Support is 7628 or so and resistance is 7789 or so now. Everything in this=chop.
text: Structure: ES is back inside the big bull flag — support 7628 or so, resistance 7789 or so. Everything inside it is chop.

source_quote: There is nothing to do from here. My job is to wait for that elevator down sell, wait for the Failed Breakdown, then we rip.
text: Nothing to do from here after the rip: the job is to wait for an elevator-down sell, wait for the Failed Breakdown, then the rip.

source_quote: While one could buy the backtest here of 7685, since it is already tested, it is much safer to wait for it to flush and recover that 10:10AM 7681 low AND 7685, then get long.
text: 7685 is 1st support down, already tested (flushed to 7681 around 10am and recovered). One could buy the backtest, but much safer to wait for a flush and recovery of the 10:10AM 7681 low AND 7685, then get long.

source_quote: Below there is 7657 and this is where things get interesting. At 2:20am, ES set a big low there from which we ripped to today’s highs. The Failed Breakdown of this low is actionable. If we can tag 7645 on this, it is a bonus.
text: Below 7685 is 7657, the 2:20am low the rip to today’s highs came from. The Failed Breakdown of this low is actionable; a tag of 7645 on it is a bonus.

source_quote: Below 7645 bulls likely dropped the ball and there is nothing until 7628. One can try to grab some points here if it is a slow, controlled sell into the zone. If we are knifing full speed, wait for it to flush and recover at least.
text: Below 7645 bulls likely dropped the ball and there is nothing until 7628. A slow, controlled sell into 7628 can be bid for some points; if knifing full speed, wait for a flush and recovery at least.

source_quote: Below there, watch for Failed Breakdowns of 7616 (we set a nice low there at 6pm last night) and obviously watch for Failed Breakdowns of 7574 which was yesterday’s big daily low.
text: Below 7628, watch for Failed Breakdowns of 7616 (the 6pm low last night) and of 7574, yesterday’s big daily low.

source_quote: Ideally bulls want to hold 7657 (or quick trap below). If we do sell bulls definitely do not want to see lower than 7628. From there, we can simply work up to 7750, then 7787 flag resistance. Likely dip there, then breakout to 7830+.
text: Bull case: defend key supports on the retrace of the rip — ideally hold 7657 (or quick trap below), and definitely no lower than 7628. From there work up to 7750, then 7787 flag resistance; likely dip there, then breakout to 7830+.

trigger.condition_text: 7657 held or quick-trapped below; no lower than 7628

source_quote: In an ultra bull case, ES won’t even lose 7687. There is nowhere to add on strength that is high quality. Perhaps recoveries of 7716 would be a higher risk option though.
text: Ultra bull case: ES won’t even lose 7687. There is nowhere high quality to add on strength; recoveries of 7716 would be a higher risk option.

source_quote: For the 7628 short, ideally price can put in one final bounce here, OR a Failed Breakdown, and then one can short beneath the lows of that bounce at 7620 or so.
text: Bear case begins below 7628. The breakdown short — offered, not taken by Mancini; expect more than 60% of these to fail — ideally comes after one final bounce at 7628 or a Failed Breakdown, shorting beneath the lows of that bounce at 7620 or so.

trigger.condition_text: below 7628, after a bounce or Failed Breakdown, beneath the bounce lows at 7620 or so

source_quote: For those who want to try though, 7789 flag resistance is the obvious spot. 7830 above there.
text: Shorts at resistance are offered only — Mancini does not short ES and has not taken one in over a year. For those who want to try, 7789 flag resistance is the obvious spot, 7830 above there.

source_quote: My lean is we keep filling this out to 7750, then 7787 flag resistance. Bulls want to defend the supports discussed above.
text: Summary: the lean is ES keeps filling out the flag to 7750, then 7787 flag resistance; bulls want to defend the supports discussed.
